summary: Firefox’s WebIDL interfaces now better match current web standards, including Permissions Policy through document.permissionsPolicy and iframe.permissionsPolicy, Fetch streaming uploads with Request.body as a ReadableStream and duplex, and Sanitizer configuration with javascript URLs. SpeechGrammarList now matches Chrome’s naming, while WebRTC session descriptions and remote candidates expose cleaner, less mutable data. These bindings let websites use newer APIs more consistently across browsers.
